       design harness showing both at once) the accessible path silently stops applying. Measured in the
       harness: :root resolved the boosted value while the themed stage inside it still resolved the
       quiet one.·

       is not \"less pretty\", it is a panel whose text no longer separates from what is behind it. So the
       veils go opaque and the lens is switched off entirely; the edges and the elevation stay, because
       they are what still says \"this is a surface above that one\" once the translucency is gone. */

       are what get fixed — at the token, so every surface that draws one is covered including the ones
